requirements.title: Slugify CLI
requirements.requirement: A command-line tool slugify.py that joins its arguments into a URL slug: lowercase ASCII letters and digits, words separated by single hyphens, punctuation and accents dropped. With no arguments, it prints a usage line to stderr and exits with code 2.

requirements.title: ISBN validator
requirements.requirement: A library isbn.py with is_valid_isbn10(s) and is_valid_isbn13(s) that accept digits with optional hyphens and verify the checksum (X is allowed only as the last ISBN-10 digit). Any other input returns False instead of raising.

requirements.title: LRU cache
requirements.requirement: A library lru.py with an LRUCache(capacity) class offering get(key, default=None) and put(key, value). Putting a new key into a full cache evicts the least recently used key, get counts as a use, and a capacity below 1 raises ValueError.
